description:
The domains competing with any domain in Google: who ranks for the most of the same keywords, how many they share, their average position on those, and each one's keyword count and estimated traffic. Big generic sites and competitors sharing too few keywords are left out. Data: DataForSEO's Google index; estimates.

Billing: 10¢ per call. Not billed when nothing comes back or the call fails; the same call within 24h is free. No-account server: one free data call a day without credit.

When to call: who a domain's search competitors are (e.g. to pick competitors to track); then get_domain_keywords on one to see what it ranks for.

Returns { domain, country, coverage: {indexed_keywords, confidence, note}, competitors: [{domain, shared_keywords, overlap_pct, avg_position, shared_keywords_traffic, organic_keywords, estimated_monthly_traffic, broad_site}], dropped_low_overlap, cached, charged_cents }. broad_site: shared keywords under 0.25% of the competitor's own (a big generic site, not a direct rival; listed last). Dropped: under 3 shared keywords, or under 1% of the domain's. confidence low: under 100 known keywords, so the list is a sample.

country.description: Google market, ISO code (US, CA, GB, AU, NZ, IE, IN, SG, ZA, AE, DE, AT, CH, FR, ES, IT, NL, SE, FI, MX, BR). Default from the TLD.

name: get_competing_domains
title: A domain's organic search competitors
